implementation: Shared half-open bounds for world-coordinate X/Y/Z whole-block slices and lower/upper cutaways.
Renderer reuses stored volume, models, texture atlas and occlusion palette; worker visits only retained cells.
Section mesh commits and picking bounds are owned by the same render request; stale/cleared jobs cannot commit.
Camera framing targets retained bounds; world-point/block focus validates the current visible stored volume.
Inspection displays stored blockstate properties, physical biome and available generation metadata; unavailable models can be skipped.
Section controls persist in browser preview settings and are excluded from generation requests/cache keys.
Existing optional texture check adapts its module-worker host to the shared clipping import.

checks: X/Y/Z slices and lower/upper cutaways expose actual model faces
Picking respects half-open clips, negative world coordinates, parallel/reverse rays and stored physical biomes
Unavailable models can be excluded from voxel picking
Renderer reuses models, palette, atlas ownership and volume when remeshing sections; camera stays unchanged until explicitly focused
Superseded/cleared section jobs cannot commit stale geometry
UI section actions persist locally without terrain generation; focus and inspection reject stale volumes
Blocks and biome arrays remain unchanged

postCheckCopyChange: Shortened only the no-visible-geometry message and invoked the already-checked section-control synchronization at initialization before asynchronous loading. Tested source hash is retained in focusedCheck; delivered source hash is retained separately.
validationNotes: Initial controlled UI stub omitted the sync callback; fixing the harness resolved the assertion without changing runtime behavior.
Controlled fixture has eight voxel cells and one model; no native generation or large-state enumeration.
limitations: Real browser DOM/WebGPU/interaction and visual qualification remain pending.
Sections retain whole stored cells; fractional triangle clipping and exact non-cube/transparent-texel picking remain unfinished.
Missing models, fluids and authoritative tints still require their pending rendering adapters/assets.
No metadata is fabricated when a volume lacks region/biome/generation values.
Full native terrain, program and release qualification remain incomplete.
